description: pi extension that connects a pi coding-agent session to the muster coordination daemon — roster registration, send_message/broadcast/join_room/leave_room/set_status tools, and real-time + per-turn delivery of sibling-agent messages. The pi-native counterpart of the Claude Code muster-shim, built on pi's extension API instead of a shim binary.
name: muster-pi

scripts.gen: cargo run -p muster-entities --no-default-features --features codegen --bin typegen -- src/generated
